details.biography:
The Broken Anvil · Level 9 - The Veterans · Seat 1, Front line

A bald, grey-skinned giant of a Jotunas goliath, his skin crawling with tribal tattoos, who swings a double-headed axe as if it weighs nothing. Loud, warm and blunt, he treats every fight as a contest he fully intends to win. The Keepers pulled his raiding band out of a goblin warren, and he pays that debt in blood and laughter.

In a fight

Get in before the enemy acts (Ambush Strike), rage on the first swing with Reckless and Brutal, and Whirlwind when three crowd you. When the troll drops, oil the axe with fire or throw a flask before it gets up.
details.backgroundStory:
Abilities (from the printed sheet)

Rage. As part of an attack or your move, rage for the rest of the encounter, 4 times a day. While raging, +2 melee weapon damage. It ends early if a full round passes without you attacking or taking damage.

Rage Styles. Each time you rage, choose two for that rage. Reckless: Advantage on your first attack roll each round, but attacks against you have Advantage. Brutal: once a round when you hit, shove the target 10ft or knock it Prone (Fortitude save, DC 17). Terrifying: once per rage, use Intimidate as part of an attack instead of your action.

Whirlwind Attack. Once per rage, while raging, replace your action: one attack roll against each of up to 3 opponents within 5ft whose Level is 4 or lower. You cannot have retreated first.

Extra Attack. When you use your action to attack, make one more weapon attack, with Disadvantage.

Intimidate (Strength). Uses your action. One creature of Level 9 or lower within 15ft makes a Will save (DC 17) or has Disadvantage on attack rolls for 1d4 rounds. No daily limit.

Primeval Will. Once a day, when you drop to 18 HP or less, gain 18 bonus HP, lost first and gone when combat ends. If you drop to 0 or below first, it triggers by itself; at 1 HP or more after it, keep fighting. It cannot stop a blow that kills you outright.

Ancestral Calling. The first time you rage each day, allies within 30ft gain 9 temporary HP until the end of the day.

Force of Nature. +1 to saves against spells and magical effects.

Iron Sinews. Your weapon attacks count as magic.

Combat Sense. Advantage on checks to avoid being surprised. Attackers gain no Advantage on you from flanking or from being Unseen, and rear-attack bonuses such as Back Attack do not work on you.

Thick Hide. +2 AC in light armour or none (included).

Primeval Instincts. Out of medium and heavy armour, Advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution checks in extreme circumstances. Hold your breath twice as long, and climb natural slopes and swim rivers at half speed without a check.

Kit: Ambush Strike. Advantage on your first attack roll each round against a target that hasn't yet acted in combat.

Kit: Desert Born. Advantage on Survival checks in arid or desert terrain, and on checks to identify Red Waste tribal markings or customs.

Goliath (Jotunas). Large: a 10ft space, 5ft more melee reach and no Heavy weapon Disadvantage, but Disadvantage on Stealth and in tight spaces. Darkvision 60ft. Resistance 5 to cold. Advantage on Strength checks to push, drag, lift or break against something smaller. Advantage on Jotunas terrain, tribal-custom and giant-lineage checks, and on Charisma checks towards Dul Khagul dwarves.

Mountain Endurance. Once a day, when hit, reduce the damage by 1d12+3 (1 Luck for another use). Advantage on Fortitude saves against exhaustion, forced marching and thin mountain air.

Toughness (1st, General). +1 HP per level and +1 Constitution (both included); Advantage on Constitution checks.

Critical Strike (2nd, Martial). Your weapon attacks score a Critical Hit on a natural 20, or on a natural 19 that hits.

Flowing Strikes (6th, Martial). Once a round, when you hit with a melee attack, make one more melee attack: with Disadvantage against the creature you hit, a normal roll against a different one in reach. It can't trigger itself.

HP. 1st level: d12 max 12 + Con 3 = 15. Levels 2 to 9: 8 x (7 + 3) = 80. Toughness: 9. Total 104.

Armour Class on the sheet: 10 + 4 (Studded Leather +1) + 1 (Dex) + 2 (Thick Hide, light armour) = 17

Class Abilities

1st Level

Combat Sense

  • Effect: Heightened battlefield awareness that makes the Barbarian difficult to catch off guard.
  • Advantage on checks to avoid being surprised
  • Attackers gain no Advantage from flanking or from being Unseen against you
  • Back Attack and similar rear-attack bonuses (such as the Rogue's) do not work against you

Rage

  • Effect: As part of an attack or your movement, enter a rage that lasts for the encounter, usable 1 + Constitution modifier times per day (minimum 2/day).
  • While raging, gain a flat bonus to melee weapon damage: +2 (1st-9th level), +4 (10th-19th level), +6 (20th+).
  • Rage ends early if a full round passes without the Barbarian attacking or taking damage.
  • Stacks normally with Primeval Will and Whirlwind Attack.

Intimidate (Strength)

  • Effect: Uses your action. One creature of equal or lower Level within 15ft makes a Will save (against your Class Save DC) or has Disadvantage on attack rolls for 1d4 rounds.
  • No daily limit

Primeval Instincts

  • Effect: When not wearing medium or heavy armour and having not fled the challenge, have Advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution checks in extreme circumstances.
  • Hold your breath twice as long as normal
  • Survive extreme temperatures and weather 1 day longer than normal
  • Advantage on Fortitude saves made to force march
  • Find shelter, food, and water for themselves automatically in any wilderness environment (1d6+2 hours)
  • Start a fire in 1d10 minutes by natural means
  • Determine true north at will
  • Climb typical natural slopes and swim typical rivers without a check — half speed, in light armour or none
  • Cannot use the shelter, fire, navigation and climbing abilities above while wearing medium or heavy armour

Thick Hide

  • Effect: While wearing no armour or light armour, gain +2 AC (+3 from 10th level). It does not stack with other bonuses of the same kind.

2nd Level

Rage Styles

  • Effect: Each time you enter a rage, choose one style. It lasts for that rage.
  • Reckless: Advantage on your first attack roll each round, but attacks against you have Advantage
  • Brutal: once per round, when you hit, shove the target 10ft or knock it Prone (Fortitude save against your Class Save DC)
  • Terrifying: once per rage, use Intimidate as part of an attack instead of your action
  • 8th level: choose two styles each time you rage

3rd Level

Whirlwind Attack

  • Effect: Once per rage, while raging, replace your action: make one attack roll against each of up to 2 opponents within 5ft whose Level is no greater than half the Barbarian's level.
  • Can split attacks between targets freely
  • Cannot retreat before using it
  • Scales with level — see the Barbarian Progression Table
  • 13th level: the targets' Level may be up to your Level

4th Level

Primeval Will

  • Effect: Once per day, when HP is reduced to twice your level or less, immediately gain bonus HP equal to twice your level.
  • The bonus HP absorb incoming damage first
  • Any remaining bonus HP are removed at combat's end
  • If reduced to 0 or negative HP before activation, it triggers automatically — if the resulting total is 1 or more HP, the Barbarian keeps fighting
  • Cannot prevent death from a blow that would kill you outright

5th Level

Ancestral Calling

  • Effect: The first time you rage each day, allies within 30ft gain temporary HP equal to your Barbarian level, lasting until the end of the day. Always on.
  • Cannot combine with another Barbarian's Ancestral Calling

6th Level

Force of Nature

  • Effect: Gain a +1 bonus to saving throws against spells and magical effects. Magic from the primeval world bends around the Barbarian's raw will.
  • Improves to +2 at 16th level
  • Improves to +3 at 19th level
  • Improves to +4 at 22nd level

7th Level

Extra Attack

  • Effect: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).

9th Level

Iron Sinews

  • Effect: Your weapon attacks count as magic, so they can harm creatures that only magic weapons can hurt.

15th Level

  • Strength Bonus: permanent +1 Strength

20th Level

Warlord

  • Effect: Once per month, in an area where the Barbarian's name and deeds are known, call up an army of 10–100 1st level barbarians.
  • Requires a population of 500 per 10 men needed in the area
  • Army stats: AC 13, armed with sword or axe
  • For every 20 barbarians, a 3rd level barbarian leads them
  • They fight for 30 days without pay — food and water only
  • Repeated failed campaigns reduce this ability until reputation is restored

24th Level

World Ender

  • Effect: Your mastery of combat reaches a mythic threshold — nothing within reach is safe, and nothing without magic stops you.
  • Whirlwind Attack can now target all creatures within 10ft regardless of Level; the normal Level cap is removed entirely

Kits: Arneyan Warrior Cultures

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Barbarian folder. Drag one onto your character.

Choose one Kit at character creation. Your kit defines the warrior culture that shaped you.

system.description:
(Constitution) Gain +1 Max HP per level (retroactive). Gain +1 to Constitution (once, on taking this feat). Advantage on Constitution-based checks.

Open to all classes by default.

You are a master of precision. Your weapon attacks score a Critical Hit on a natural 20, or on a natural 19 that hits.

Available to: Fighters, Barbarians, Knights, Paladins, Magi, Bards, Rangers, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, Rogues, Assassins, and Monks.

Once per round, when you hit a creature with a melee attack, let the momentum carry through — make one extra melee attack.

  • Against the creature you just hit it is rolled with Disadvantage; against a different creature within your reach it is a normal roll.
  • The extra attack cannot trigger Flowing Strikes again.

Available to: Fighters, Barbarians, Knights, Paladins, Magi, Bards, Rangers, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, Rogues, Assassins, and Monks.
